statement: Let S be the set of all integers s for which there exists an index sequence (i_0, ..., i_{m-1}) such that m >= 1, 0 <= i_0 < ... < i_{m-1} < len(nums), i_{t+1} - i_t <= k for every 0 <= t < m-1, and s = nums[i_0] + ... + nums[i_{m-1}]. The function returns a result r (so it does not fail) such that r is the maximum of S: r is in S and s <= r for every s in S. Equivalently, r is the maximum sum of a non-empty subsequence of nums whose selected indices, taken in increasing order, have every gap between consecutive selected indices at most k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: Let P be the sum of nums[i] over all indices i with nums[i] > 0, using P = 0 if there are no positive entries. The function returns a result r and r <= P.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not overflow, panic, or fail on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = nums[0].
preconditions: len(nums) = 1; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = max { nums[a] + nums[a+1] + ... + nums[b] | 0 <= a <= b < len(nums) }, i.e. the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray of nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; k = 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: Let P be the sum of nums[i] over all indices i with nums[i] > 0, using P = 0 if there are no positive entries, and let M be the maximum of nums[i] over 0 <= i < len(nums). If there exists an index i with nums[i] > 0, then the function returns result r = P; otherwise it returns result r = M.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); k >= len(nums) - 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = max { nums[i] | 0 <= i < len(nums) }.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] <= 0 and -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an index sequence (i_0, ..., i_{m-1}) such that m >= 1, 0 <= i_0 < ... < i_{m-1} < len(nums), i_{t+1} - i_t <= k for every 0 <= t < m-1, and r = nums[i_0] + ... + nums[i_{m-1}].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every index sequence (i_0, ..., i_{m-1}) with m >= 1, 0 <= i_0 < ... < i_{m-1} < len(nums), and i_{t+1} - i_t <= k for every 0 <= t < m-1, we have nums[i_0] + ... + nums[i_{m-1}] <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: Let r1 be the result of constrained_subset_sum nums k1 and let r2 be the result of constrained_subset_sum nums k2. Both calls return results and r1 <= r2.
preconditions: For every slice nums and all integers k1, k2 with 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000, 1 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(nums), and every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: Let rev be the slice of length len(nums) with rev[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for every 0 <= i < len(nums). Let r be the result of constrained_subset_sum nums k and let r' be the result of constrained_subset_sum rev k. Both calls return results and r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4.

statement: Let r be the result of constrained_subset_sum nums k and let r' be the result of constrained_subset_sum nums' k. Both calls return results and r <= r'.
preconditions: For any two slices nums and nums' with len(nums) = len(nums') and 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000, any integer k with 1 <= k <= len(nums), and every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^4 <= nums[i] <= nums'[i] <= 10^4.
